description: The Bus Open Data Service (BODS) is the Department for Transport's official source of data on local bus services in England. Under the Bus Services Act 2017 all public bus operators in England must publish their data there from 2020, and it provides timetables, vehicle locations and fares for every local bus service, together with operator profiles (with national operator codes and licence numbers), local transport authority profiles on data quality, and a data catalogue matching the different dataset types. Coverage is national for England's local bus and coach services. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): OGL-UK-3.0 (BODS site: all content under OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated). Caveats: quality depends on what operators publish, which the service rates by local authority, and the service is still labelled beta. The timetables and live locations support public transit network models, service reliability analysis and disruption and resilience studies of bus networks. BODS is related to the GTFS specification and the Mobility Database, which lists transit feeds worldwide. Access is through the provider page linked in this record.
